questions.prompt: What does Fern notice when she stops searching and listens?
choices: Small glowing shoots are coming from the ground.
The empty seed box is hidden under a log.
A trail of loose seeds leads into the marsh.
questions.answer: Small glowing shoots are coming from the ground.
questions.evidenceText:
There were small green shoots in the ground.
They glowed.
Just a little.
Just like the seeds.

questions.prompt: Why is the magic seed box empty?
choices: Fern planted the seeds and forgot that she had done it.
The stream carried the seeds away at night.
Luna shared the seeds among the forest animals.
questions.answer: Fern planted the seeds and forgot that she had done it.
questions.rationale: Fern remembers that she planted the seeds and had not meant to forget, showing that she planted them and later forgot that she had done it.
questions.evidenceText:
Two nights ago she had been in the clearing.
She had planted the seeds.
She had not meant to forget.

questions.prompt: What made Moonwood glow more than ever that night?
choices: The empty seed box lit the ground.
The search spells lit every path.
questions.evidenceText:
That night, Moonwood glowed more than ever.
The seedlings lit the ground.
